description: Aircraft monument standing on the museum grounds at the junction of Jalan Muzium and Jalan Taming Sari, about 35 m from the Perak Museum building. Mapped in OpenStreetMap as a military exhibit described simply as Sabre Fighter Aircraft. No serial has been published, and the variant is left blank: the RMAF operated only ex-RAAF CA-27 Sabre Mk.32s, but that has not been confirmed for this particular airframe and no photograph of its markings was located.
